ISSUE-001 instead concerns an endpoint equality case violating a stationarity axiom for a scalar certificate; it does not diagnose the missing trajectory-domain hypothesis or its use in the tracking estimate.

ISSUE-001 addresses a different scalar certificate and a different endpoint stationarity equality; it does not identify the approximation boundary formula or the missing equality-case argument.
